message: Black Friday is on, as planned. Rapid Parcel's drivers' union has said it may strike from December 1, and Rapid Parcel says it would keep delivering more slowly. We have booked 40% more capacity at Meridian and Dash for the next two weeks. Some parcels may still take longer than usual.
why: Most Black Friday orders ship in week 5.
Extra capacity is the only lever on delivery delay.

message: For the next six weeks Aisle pays sellers twice a week instead of weekly, so a slow parcel does not hold up your cash.
why: Small sellers have tight cash flow.
